title: Resume optimization safely after restarts and corrected labels
description:
## Behavior and acceptance
Durably version votes, comments, assignments, predictions made before voting, bundles, jobs and events. Undo/correct invalidates dependent candidates/features/fits as appropriate; preserve history and immutable historical prediction scores. Resume interrupted work idempotently with cached complete fingerprints and recorded usage, no duplicate paid calls. Handle stable source IDs/content revisions without overwriting labeled items.
Scenario: interruption and restart yields the same active bundle; corrected label cannot leave a dependent fit silently current.

## Constraints
Native provider-neutral library only; no DSPy. The application does not implement a second flywheel. Optimizer proposes; code validates/applies; numerical fitting alone sets weights and calibration. Training, development, random audit and sealed scoreboard remain separated. No credentials or private article text in committed artifacts. Specs first with fake clients; live calls explicit and budgeted.
